rows.en:
I'm Nozomu Kazama.
Third-year.
I hear the school paper's doing a feature on the school's seven wonders, but I'm not too impressed with the idea.
If you're going to go through with this, it means you'd better be ready for what comes.
I mean, wouldn't you agree?
Spirits are sacred things.
Mess with them half for fun, and you'll get burned.
Don't you feel it?
The unnatural air swirling around this room?

I can feel it.
I've had chills all over my body for a while now.
Places where evil energy like this gathers draw wandering spirits from out of nowhere.
And they keep watch on us, without a sound.
They're waiting for us to let our guard down, even for an instant.
Why are they waiting, you ask?{p}

To drag us into a world of terror.
For evil spirits, human fear is the finest main dish there is.
So you mustn't let your guard down.
Not for a single moment.
Let it down even a little, and you'll be prey for the evil dead gathered here.
This project isn't as easy as you think.
The further the stories go, the less anyone can say what will happen.
If you keep going like this, something terrible is bound to happen.
To you.
Well?{p}Do you still have the courage to go on with this?
Go on
Stop now

Oh? You're quitting already?
You've got less nerve than I thought.
Well, that's fine too.
Quitting is your call.
But I'm going to tell my story anyway.{p}

After all, that's what I came here for.
If you want to quit, you can just walk out of this room on your own.
But I'm going to tell my story regardless.
I think that's my duty, and my right.
Got it?
Don't shake like that.
You're the one who wanted to hear scary stories, aren't you?{p}

Now then, would you take a look at this photo?
I took it at last year's school festival.
It came out nicely, right?
Believe it or not, I'm pretty confident in my photography.
It's a completely ordinary photo, isn't it?
Just two high school girls in it.
Do you feel anything when you look at it?
Actually, this is a spirit photo.
No, it's no wonder if you don't feel anything.
I didn't notice a thing myself until someone actually told me.
I have an uncle with an extremely strong sixth sense.
Apparently he's something of a big name in that line.
It seems he gets called in pretty often whenever there's that kind of incident.
Of course, he appraises spirit photos too.
That uncle of mine was idly looking through my album.
Of course, it's not like I'd asked him to appraise anything.
He was just looking, idly, the way a relative does.

Flip, flip went the pages of the album.
My uncle was looking through it with a grin, having fun.
Then, suddenly, his finger stopped.
The smile vanished from his face, and his eyes were glued to one photo.

"Nozomu! Where did you take this photo?"
It wasn't my uncle's usual gentle face.
It was a stern face, and yet it looked frightened of something too.
I'd never seen my uncle look that scary.
"...Where? I took it at school. During the school festival, I think."
When I said that, my uncle stared hard at the photo again.
"Is this girl your friend? The girl on the left here."
"Yes. She's in my class, but..."
I'll tell you what I thought.
I thought my uncle had pretty good taste for his age.
"How is this girl doing now? Is she all right?"
Out of nowhere, he asked something strange.
I figured my uncle, at his age, had his eye on her, but that didn't seem to be it.
"A child has latched on to this girl. That child shows up clearly in this photo."
That's what he started saying.
I hurriedly snatched the photo away from him.

But I couldn't see anything.
Just like you right now.
"You can't see it? Look closely.
You should be able to see it clearly too. There's a child in the photo, right on her leg."
Saying that, my uncle pointed at the photo.

A chill ran down my spine.
I could tell there was something unknowable in that photo.
Even so, I couldn't see any child's ghost.
The girl in the photo had no strange rumors about her; she was a perfectly cheerful, lively girl.
I couldn't imagine a spirit like that cursing her, so I stared at the photo with my eyes wide as saucers.
And then, what do you know?

"Ah!"
A cry slipped out of me.
Would you believe it, I could see it.
This photo was cursed, all right.
There was a child clinging tight to her leg.
Clinging tight, so it would never come off.
Can't you see it?
Around the knee.
Look, there's a child clinging tight to her knee, isn't there?{p}
That child's name is... the Kneecap Kid.{p}

...The Kneecap Kid.
A kid stuck on a kneecap, so: the Kneecap Kid.
Scary, right?{p}............ Lame?
It was lame.
It was really scary.

It was lame?
No way, right?
You were actually scared, weren't you?
I wouldn't mind if you said it was funny, either.
This story always goes over great with everyone.
Well, I guess it just didn't match your vibe.
You look like you've got bad taste, after all.{p}Scary stories are fine and all, but if you can't get a joke, you'll never be popular with girls.
Mind your own business.
Maybe you're right.

Everyone's appalled.
At least, I thought so, and the others were looking down, bored, so there was no doubt about it.
Seriously, what is with this Nozomu Kazama guy?
Did he really come all this way just to tell a story like that?
And Hino's just as bad.
He could've invited someone a little more normal.
Ugh, now he's scratching his head, scritch-scratch.
He looks kind of grubby.
"It wasn't funny? That's weird, it always gets huge laughs."
Kazama was muttering to himself.
Suddenly he rolled up his pant leg and started scratching his leg, scritch-scratch.{p}Hey, I wish he wouldn't do something so crude, out of nowhere, right here.

"Huh?"
I caught my breath.
Didn't I just see something?
Kazama's leg.
...Yes, right at the kneecap.
At his kneecap, I'd seen a child's face.
One of those jinmenso: a sore with a human face.
It looked my way and gave a nasty grin.

"Kazama!"
I couldn't help shouting.
Kazama was looking at me with a blank expression.
He had already rolled his pant leg back down; there was no way to check.
I could hardly ask him to scratch his leg again...
"What's the matter? So you did find my story interesting after all?"
"Ah... yes."
I gave a vague answer.
The thing I'd seen on Kazama's knee... was it just my eyes playing tricks after all?
Because I'd heard a story like that?{p}

"That's the end of my story. Too bad I couldn't live up to your expectations, but don't you have others waiting? Why not hear the next story?"
Urged on by Kazama, I looked around at everyone's faces.
That's right.
The stories had only just begun.
Whose story should I hear next...{p}

Ah.
Before that, hmm... I'm kind of thirsty.{p}Could you get me some water?
Bring some
Don't bring any

What?
Don't glare at me.
The story I'm about to tell is seriously dangerous.
That's how bad it is: I'm saying stuff like this to buy even a little more time.
Well, fine.{p}If you want to hear it that badly, I'll tell you.

Ah, thanks.
I'll just have a little.

But I didn't have you bring this water just so I could drink it.
I need one person... yes, you. {a}, was it?
Would you hold this glass of water for me?
I can see things, you know.
I can make something terrifying appear, reflected in the water of a glass.

I have that kind of power.
What's wrong?
No need to be scared.
Now then, first, peer into the water in this glass.
Strain your eyes.

Can you see it?
An animal's black hair.
This is a terrifying creature.
You can see two holes, can't you?
Those holes are important to this animal.
You could even call them its weak point.
If this animal ever attacks you, just jab something into those holes.
Be careful.
Listen, you need to be careful.
I'm going to call this animal's name.
Once its name is called, it should bare its teeth and attack.
When it does, listen, aim for the two holes and stab something into them.
Are you scared?
All right, I'll fight it for you.
Okay, here goes.
I'm calling the animal's name.
The animal's name is...{p}

{a}! It's you☆
The animal with black hair and two nostrils is you☆
The animal reflected in the glass is you☆{p}Come on, bring it☆
Pounce on him
Be dumbfounded

What is with this guy☆
Upperclassman or not, I didn't care: I lunged at him.{p}

"See, there it is, baring its teeth and attacking☆
Just like I said☆"
I was absolutely furious!{p}Then Kazama jabbed two fingers up my nostrils☆
Ow... that hurts☆
Oh... that feels good☆

...Huh?
Why?
You're not going to jump at me?
The important part was coming next.
If you went wild, I was going to shove my fingers up your nostrils and say,
"The nostrils are a human weak spot!"
and show off how much I know.{p}.........Don't tell me, you think it's lame?
It's lame.
If that was the plan, I wish you'd done it to me.

Ow... that hurts☆
"See, everything's just like I said.
The human animal has a weak spot in the nose, too!
Hahahahaha☆
Oh, that's hilarious!

...Huh?
What's up?
It's funny, right?
Why are you all so quiet?"
.........
Everyone was dead silent.
What an incredible person, though.
Why did Hino invite someone like this?
All the commotion had made me thirsty, and I glanced at the glass of water.{p}

Ah...
The glass was cracked.
Why?
I didn't remember breaking it.
What on earth...
"Whoa!"
That startled me.
Someone had tapped me on the shoulder.
Who...?{p}

......Oh, it's just Kazama.
"{a}, you broke the glass, didn't you?
That's awful, damaging school property.
That's why I say you're an animal."
......I'll just leave this guy alone from now on.
But why had the glass been cracked?
Is there really something in this school?
Though something didn't sit right with me, I decided to hear the next story.
"Well then, shall we move on to the next one..."{p}

Oh... that feels good☆
I found myself drunk on the pleasure.

"...{a}?"
Kazama said.
"Wh-wh-wh-what's wrong?
What's with that face?
Don't tell me... it feels good?{p}

...Cut it out.
You're scary, you know that?
Your attitude is scarier than my story."
Talk about getting trashed.

When I happened to look around, everyone was staring at me as if I were something disgusting.
Oh no.
This can't go on.
At this rate, there'd be no interview.
I hurried to smooth things over.{p}

"It must be the work of a spirit.
I really did feel good just now.
But I think a spirit that came here made me feel that way.
Think about it.
If Kazama had kept his fingers in my nostrils and I'd kept on enjoying it...
I might have gotten a cut inside my nose, germs might have gotten in, and I could have gotten sick.
I believe this is a spirit's scheme.
Please be careful, everyone.
It seems there really are spirits in this school..."
Everyone had complicated looks on their faces.
I know I'm the one saying it, but who could say for sure that what just happened wasn't the work of a spirit?
I really did feel good.
But isn't that strange?
Getting fingers jammed up your nostrils and feeling good...
That's right. It has to be the work of a spirit.
Before anyone could poke holes in it, I decided to hear the next story.
"Now, let's start the next story.
Who's next?"{p}

"Hmph, fine.
That's fine.
If that's how you want it, I've got ideas of my own."
Kazama was muttering something.
Great.
Why did Hino invite someone like this? I wondered.
And is this guy really a third-year?
He acts so childish.
Even if this room were full of spirit energy, no ghost would come near with someone like him around.

Huh?
What was that sound?

What a weird sound.
Like nothing I'd ever heard...

"I told you, didn't I?
That I felt something abnormal in the air in this room.
That's why I clowned around on purpose, to try to change the atmosphere.
Well, fine.
If you want to tell serious ghost stories, go ahead.
But whatever happens, I can't take responsibility for it..."
Everyone fell silent.
In the quiet room, only the rapping echoed for a while.
Then Kazama spoke.
"Well, you're moving on to the next story, right?
Who's up next?"{p}
"All right! I know just how you feel!"{p}Kazama shoved two fingers up my nostrils☆
Ow... that hurts☆
Oh... that feels good☆

"Wow, how pathetic.
Why should I have to help with an interview for someone like this?"

Kazama arrogantly put his feet up on the desk.
What is with this guy?
I don't want to interview someone like this either.
"Ew, stop putting your feet on the desk."
Someone said it.
Yes, exactly.
I wanted to tell him he was the one who'd be way less popular with girls.
"What? Fine, fine.
Hang on, my leg's itchy."
Kazama suddenly rolled up his pant leg and started scratching his leg, scritch-scratch.
Hey, I wish he wouldn't do something so crude, out of nowhere, right here.{p}

You're such a scaredy-cat. What are you going to do from here on?
If you're a man, you're going to take a wife and protect your home someday, right?
How pathetic.
You'll never be popular with girls like that.{p}
